headline: One photo, 146 different works
reasons: The same photo file (fingerprint 533cdf477b86) is attached to 146 different works in 4 villages. A photo of one site cannot be evidence for 146 separate works.
The works are recorded as: Contour Trench (146).
These works are spread over 4 blocks: Dakore, Kadaura, Kuthaund, Maheva.
